crashReports.description: Self-contained reports written by the Rust crash handler (panics) and the out-of-process minidump monitor (native faults). Each carries a full backtrace or .dmp, system details, and a redacted config snapshot.
crashReports.desktopOnly: Native crash reports are only available in the desktop app.
crashReports.empty: No crash reports — nothing has crashed.
crashReports.title: Native crash reports

developer.chatMiddlewareHint: Experimental. Let enabled plugins wrap each send via their registered chat middleware. Off by default — no effect unless a plugin provides one.
developer.debugModeHint: Verbose logs from the SDK and any spawned MCP / sub-process. Look for them in the Tauri dev console or the sidecar log file.
developer.description: Low-level toggles for debugging and experimental plugin behavior.
developer.title: Developer flags

inboxTelemetry.description: Breadcrumb log of recent inbox events (inbound, outbound, breaker, quiet hours, A2UI downgrade). Capped at 3000 rows; rotates fastest first.
inboxTelemetry.emptyExport: Nothing to export — the telemetry ring is empty.
inboxTelemetry.rowCount: {count, plural, =0 {No events captured yet} =1 {1 event captured} other {# events captured}}
inboxTelemetry.title: Inbox telemetry

pluginMessaging.description: Live inter-plugin messaging — exposed RPC methods, active channels, and circuit-breaker health across the IPC and event-bus singletons.
pluginMessaging.exposedEmpty: No plugin has exposed any RPC methods.
pluginMessaging.title: Plugin messaging

sandboxAudit.description: Recent sandbox_exec calls — allow / deny / error, command, duration. Mirrors the in-memory audit ring.
sandboxAudit.title: Sandbox event log

service.title: Diagnostic service
service.description: Where crash reports from this account are submitted, and the service the triage console reads.
service.sessionStored: A session is stored in the system keychain
service.sessionDescription: Submitting your own crashes needs no token: the desktop app proves its installation with its own key. A token from your identity provider is what promotes this connection to reading and triaging everyone's reports. It is stored in the system keychain and never in the app database.
service.browserTransport: In a browser, requests reach the service only if it opts into CORS. The desktop and mobile apps have a direct transport.
service.autoSubmitDescription: Off by default. When on, a captured crash is packaged and sent without the consent preview — minidumps and screenshots are still never included unless you ask for them per report.

errors.url: Enter an http or https service URL.
errors.ids: Tenant and project IDs must be UUIDs.
errors.save: The connection could not be saved.

sidecarRestart.description: How many times the Node sidecar has spawned since the app booted. A growing count usually means SDK errors are causing automatic restarts.
sidecarRestart.title: Sidecar restarts
